messages.content: 你能幫我計算我的儲蓄的複利嗎？我最初投資了5000美元作為本金。銀行提供每年2.5％的利率（或以小數形式表示的0.025）。我計劃將我的錢存入銀行10年。此外，利息是每季度複利，因此一年複利4次。你能計算前2年的複利，然後再計算接下來的3年，最後再計算剩下的5年的複利嗎？

function.name: calculate_compound_interest
function.description: Calculate compound interest for an initial principal amount. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The principal amount that the interest is applied to.

rate.description: The annual interest rate. Enter as a decimal. E.g, 5% is 0.05 This is a float type value.

time.description: The time the money is invested for in years.

n.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per time period. Default is 1.

message.content:
**Compound‑interest calculation**

The compound‑interest formula is  

\[
A=P\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}
\]

where  

* \(P\) – principal (initial amount)  
* \(r\) – annual nominal interest rate (decimal)  
* \(n\) – compounding frequency per year  
* \(t\) – time in years  
* \(A\) – accumulated amount after \(t\) years  

---

### 1️⃣ First 2 years  

| Symbol | Value |
|--------|-------|
| \(P_0\) | \$5 000 |
| \(r\)   | 0.025 |
| \(n\)   | 4 (quarterly) |
| \(t\)   | 2 |

\[
A_2 = 5000 \left(1+\frac{0.025}{4}\right)^{4\times 2}
     = 5000 \times 1.00625^{8}
     \approx 5000 \times 1.05107
     \approx \$5\,255.35
\]

So after **2 years** you would have about **\$5 255.35**.

---

### 2️⃣ Next 3 years (from year 2 to year 5)

Now the new principal is the amount from year 2:

\(P_1 = \$5\,255.35\).

Time span: \(t = 3\) years → \(nt = 4\times3 = 12\) compounding periods.

\[
A_5 = 5255.35 \left(1+\frac{0.025}{4}\right)^{12}
     = 5255.35 \times 1.00625^{12}
     \approx 5255.35 \times 1.07735
     \approx \$5\,661.85
\]

After **5 years** you would have about **\$5 661.85**.

---

### 3️⃣ Remaining 5 years (from year 5 to year 10)

New principal: \(P_2 = \$5\,661.85\).

Time span: \(t = 5\) years → \(nt = 4\times5 = 20\) compounding periods.

\[
A_{10}= 5661.85 \left(1+\frac{0.025}{4}\right)^{20}
      = 5661.85 \times 1.00625^{20}
      \approx 5661.85 \times 1.13261
      \approx \$6\,411.67
\]

After **10 years** you would have about **\$6 411.67**.

---

#### Summary table

| Period | Principal at start | Accumulated amount |
|--------|--------------------|--------------------|
| 0–2 yr | \$5 000            | \$5 255.35         |
| 2–5 yr | \$5 255.35         | \$5 661.85         |
| 5–10 yr| \$5 661.85         | **\$6 411.67**     |

> **Rounded to two decimals**:  
> • After 2 yrs: **$5,255.35**  
> • After 5 yrs: **$5,661.85**  
> • After 10 yrs: **$6,411.67**

These figures assume the bank compounds quarterly at a fixed 2.5 % annual rate and that no additional deposits or withdrawals are made during the 10‑year period.
